skills.name: agent-prompt
skills.title: Prompt for an agent
skills.description: Goal, context, constraints, done when. Turns a spoken request into instructions for a coding or chat agent; use in an AI assistant app.

skills.name: clean-up
skills.title: Clean up
skills.description: Punctuation, fillers and false starts. Fixes dictated text without changing what was said; use when the words are right and only the transcription is rough.

skills.name: concise
skills.title: Concise
skills.description: Same message, fewer words. Cuts repetition and padding from dictation; use when you rambled.

skills.name: email
skills.title: Email
skills.description: Greeting, clear paragraphs, sign-off. Turns dictation into an email body ready to paste; use when writing an email.

skills.name: friendly-message
skills.title: Friendly message
skills.description: Warm and conversational. Turns dictation into a text message in your own voice; use in messaging apps.

skills.name: meeting-notes
skills.title: Meeting notes
skills.description: Summary, decisions and actions. Turns a spoken meeting recap into notes; use after a meeting or call.

skills.name: notes
skills.title: Notes
skills.description: Heading and bullet points. Turns a spoken brain dump into tidy notes; use in a notes app.

skills.name: professional
skills.title: Professional
skills.description: Polished and businesslike. Rewrites dictation in a professional tone without making it stiff; use for clients, managers or anything formal.

skills.name: social-post
skills.title: Social post
skills.description: One clear post in your voice. Turns dictation into a social media post; use in X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads or Mastodon.

skills.name: summary
skills.title: Summary
skills.description: The key points, shorter. Use when a long dictation needs to become a quick read.

skills.name: todo-list
skills.title: To-do list
skills.description: Tasks you can tick off. Turns spoken errands and commitments into a checklist; use in a to-do app.

skills.name: unslop
skills.title: Unslop
skills.description: Plain, human wording without AI or corporate filler. Removes clichés, buzzwords, hedging and stock phrases; use when text sounds generated or padded.

skills.name: work-chat
skills.title: Work chat
skills.description: Short, clear and friendly for a team channel. Turns dictation into a work chat message; use in Slack, Teams or Google Chat.
